 Follow MAGA Movie Star Makes Wild Claim About Visit From Jesus
 The Daily Beast Updated Wed, November 11, 2026 at 9:30 PM UTC Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Jim Caviezel has revealed that he played Jesus Christ in The Passion of the Christ because Jesus himself told him to.The Passion of the Christ, which Trump-loving filmmaker Mel Gibson wrote and directed, came out in 2004. The biblical drama follows Jesus' final 12 hours before his crucifixion. Gibson has created a sequel, The Resurrection of the Christ: Part One and Part Two, an epic that depicts the immediate aftermath of the first film's events; Finnish actor Jaakko Ohtonen will play Jesus in Caviezel's place to maintain age continuity.Caviezel is an outspoken MAGA supporter and has called President Donald Trump, 80, "the new Moses." He's also publicly spewed wild QAnon conspiracy theories about liberal elites harvesting children's blood. He even echoed the right-wing conspiracy group's talking points on The Charlie Kirk Show podcast in 2023.
